title: [BUG] KeyError when using models from huggingface
author: caojiaolong

comments.author: rwightman
comments.body:
@caojiaolong that's a transformers only model, will not work with timm. `timm` actually has a LOT more (and better) mobilenet weights than transformers so suggest looking in the timm or (or via the library)

The closest `timm` models to that one are
`mobilenetv2_100.ra_in1k`
`mobilenetv2_110d.ra_in1k`

https://huggingface.co/models?sort=downloads&search=timm+mobilenet

for m in timm.list_pretrained('*mobilenet*'):
    print(m)
